findings.detail: The v3 launch package is DEAD ON ARRIVAL on its own frozen bytes, and this is disclosed nowhere. A7 executed the cycle's own scored pipeline (run_v17_cell --smoke, T2.0 primary, real manifest-sha-verified panels; smoke changes only the output namespace) at the audited HEAD: ALL SIX selected cells fail their first gate. ATTN-PHASE anchor/neighbour/control G1 margins -0.001716/-0.000374/-0.000455 (expectancy <= 0 after tier-2.0 costs; PF 0.620/0.896/0.849, 0-1/3 folds, G4/G5 failing downstream). OICASCADE anchor/neighbour G1 margins -0.000166/-0.000083 (control sham G1 +0.000030 hair-pass then G2 fail - the unconditional-long sham OUT-EARNS both mechanism arms, the falsification shadow in the worst direction). The OICASCADE family is additionally DEAD_FROZEN_RULES in the driver's own fail-closed enforcement record: K1 control_reproduces (anchor per-trip expectancy -0.00266 vs sham +0.00149 over 135/135 booked trips; |sham| >= 0.5x|anchor| and positive) and K2 fold_negative_majority (F0 -0.00383 / F1 +0.00025 / F2 -0.00760 = 2 of 3 folds <= 0; populations 52/60/23, NO unevaluable folds) - K2's implementation matches the frozen text exactly, so the death does not depend on the K1 sign-reading nuance. Because S0 IS the frozen panel window (panels end 2026-08-21T23, S1 SEALED, determinism twin + A7 sanitized x2 + smoke byte-identical modulo the code_freeze_sha identity field), the scored execution being authorized is a deterministic recomputation whose every outcome field is already determined: V17_REJECT_ALL, 0/6 cells surviving. The cycle's own Q-phase twin smoke ALREADY COMPUTED these identical margins (integration worktree results/v17_smoke/V17-A6-P2-OICASCADE, byte-identical to A7's run except the code_freeze_sha identity field pinned at 8d5aa41), yet prelaunch_package_v3_v17.json, q_phase_report.json, q_twin_smoke_v17.json and selection_freeze_v3_v17.json disclose none of it - the package discloses the razor novelty margin (0.1979) but not that both selected families fail every primary gate on the bytes the owner is being asked to authorize. This is the same finding class as v1 (rule-4 coverage measured from Q bytes) and v2 (frozen-rule dead family), scaled to the whole package; the two-key gate's key 1 requires 0 unresolved HIGH, and an authorization that omits a measured all-cells-dead outcome would deny the owner the informed consent the two-key design exists to provide. v1/v2 kills were ACCEPTED mechanically; consistency compels the same treatment here.

Q v3 evidence bundling is inverted and the audited HEAD's working tree is dirty: the CURRENT selection's per-arm sanitized evidence (9 OICASCADE decisions files across q_dry_run + snaps/run1 + snaps/run2) is UNTRACKED, while the DEAD v2 family's (WKNDLIQ) evidence is committed at HEAD and has been DELETED from disk by the Q runner's qroot cleanup (recoverable from git); full_suite_output.txt is modified on disk by a post-Q suite rerun; the committed q_phase_report.json/q_twin_smoke_v17.json embed no hashes of the arm files they summarize, so the commit message's 'Q evidence v3 bundled' holds only for the two summary JSONs, not the per-arm evidence. F2/fda78bd committed-bytes-vs-working-tree class recurrence (third+ instance, twice disclosed before). Mitigation verified: A7's fresh sanitized runs are byte-identical to all three on-disk OICASCADE copies, so the untracked bytes are genuine driver output; the non-vacuity/determinism claims are true. No repair performed per audit mandate.

The OICASCADE spec's fail-closed K3 record (frozen_falsification_rules.ancestry_veto_measured.measured_pooled_abs_rho = 0.1899, margin 0.0101) and selection_freeze_v3's thin-margins register carry the novelty measured on the closure-bug (per-symbol byte-identical) OI cache; the corrected measurement in the committed d2_novelty_endpoint_v17.json is 0.1979 vs panel_daily:ret (spearman), margin 0.0021 - THINNEST of the cycle, disclosed in prelaunch_package_v3 but never reconciled into the spec the driver mechanically checks or the freeze artifact. No remediation path exists inside the current frozen data: the families cannot be made alive without new data or a new owner plan (lane 1 is already dead; the cross-lane survivor set is now measured empty). Owner options: (a) accept the pre-measured REJECT_ALL as V17's terminal without spending the scored run/budget, recording this artifact as the decisive measurement, or (b) override with full knowledge and run S0 anyway - both require the owner to read this verdict first per P-8.
notes: Everything else audits clean from bytes, and several v3-specific mechanisms are genuinely strong: the warmup-extended OI authority (sha-exact, per-symbol distinct, 484x3 manifested), the OICASCADE implementation's 1:1 fidelity (A7's independent gate re-implementation matches the driver's booked population exactly), the fail-closed frozen-rule machinery (observed actually firing), the diagnostic gate (3x PASS 0 HIGH with recorded blocks matching fresh runs), sanitized determinism (x2 + all three evidence copies byte-identical), and ATTN-PHASE byte-stability since the v2-audited state. The refusal is narrow and outcome-shaped, exactly like v1 and v2: the machinery faithfully measures strategies that do not survive their own frozen gates on the frozen window. A wrong refuse costs a day; authorizing a package whose scored execution is predetermined to reject everything - without saying so - would cost the cycle's integrity and the owner's informed consent.
